modern: How small a part of boundless and unfathomable time is assigned to every man, for it is very soon swallowed up in eternity! And how small a part of the whole substance; and how small a part of the universal soul; and on what a small clod of the whole earth you crawl! Reflecting on all this, consider nothing to be great, except to act as your nature leads you, and to endure what the common nature brings.
original: How small a part of the boundless and unfathomable time is assigned to every man, for it is very soon swallowed up in the eternal! And how small a part of the whole substance; and how small a part of the universal soul; and on what a small clod of the whole earth thou creepest! Reflecting on all this, consider nothing to be great, except to act as thy nature leads thee, and to endure that which the common nature brings.

explained.summary: Each of us gets a tiny sliver of endless time, quickly swallowed by eternity, a tiny share of all matter and of the universal soul, and a tiny clod of earth to crawl about on. Seeing this, treat nothing as great except acting as your own nature leads you and bearing what nature as a whole brings. Marcus isn’t belittling life, just putting status and possessions in proportion.
